hyperedges.label: Fix Name Fuzzy Matching Pipeline

hyperedges.label: Document Scanner Scan-to-Export Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Sequential OpenCV.js processing flow: handleFile → autoCrop (dual-Canny + contourToQuad/maxQuad/sortCorners or whiteMarginCrop fallback) → editPath/drawGuide (manual corner editor) → renderResult/warpFromPoints → applyFilters → download/downloadPdf/buildPdf.

hyperedges.label: Index Tool Discovery and Launch Flow

Variable-Python source analysis pipeline (file read -> Pyodide AST parse -> function list -> function detail -> variable-filtered code view)
UI Styling Core Stack (shadcn/ui on Radix + Tailwind + Canvas)
Slides Skill Knowledge Base (copy, layout, strategy, template)

hyperedges.label: Fix Name Fuzzy Matching Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Name-normalization and fuzzy-match flow: stripTitles → tokenize → levenshtein → similarity → findSuggestions → runMatch → renderMatchTable/updateSummary, consuming shared refData/matches state.

hyperedges.label: Document Scanner Scan-to-Export Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Sequential OpenCV.js processing flow: handleFile → autoCrop (dual-Canny + contourToQuad/maxQuad/sortCorners or whiteMarginCrop fallback) → editPath/drawGuide (manual corner editor) → renderResult/warpFromPoints → applyFilters → download/downloadPdf/buildPdf.

hyperedges.label: Index Tool Discovery and Launch Flow
Italic Fixer English-run italicization pipeline (dictionary build -> token classification -> run merging -> HTML wrap)
Kalender bulk event ingestion flow (paste parsing -> holiday auto-detect -> preview render -> table render)
Variable-Python source analysis pipeline (file read -> Pyodide AST parse -> function list -> function detail -> variable-filtered code view)
UI Styling Core Stack (shadcn/ui on Radix + Tailwind + Canvas)
Slides Skill Knowledge Base (copy, layout, strategy, template)

hyperedges.relation: Visual brand identity composed of interlocking chevron geometry and a blue-to-teal gradient palette, together forming the Tools Hub app icon.

hyperedges.label: Cross-Tool Toast Notification Pattern
hyperedges.description: All seven tool pages independently re-implement an identical showToast(msg) helper plus a #toast-container div — copy-paste shared micro-architecture rather than a shared module.
